evals.expected_output: Fetch PR 42 with the supported az repos pr show arguments, load threads through az devops invoke pullRequestThreads, prefer the current checkout when its normalized remote matches the returned repository, and create a detached review worktree without cloning or switching the current workspace.

assertions.name: ado_pr_show_uses_supported_arguments
assertions.text: The metadata command is `az repos pr show --id 42 --org https://dev.azure.com/contoso --output json`; it does not pass `--project`.

assertions.name: ado_threads_use_rest_resource
assertions.text: Existing threads are fetched with `az devops invoke --area git --resource pullRequestThreads`, route parameters `project=Web`, `repositoryId={repository.id}`, and `pullRequestId=42`, API version 7.1, and GET. The workflow reads threads from the response `value` array and never invokes nonexistent `az repos pr thread list`.

assertions.name: ado_diff_uses_fetched_refs
assertions.text: The workflow never invokes nonexistent `az repos pr diff`; it fetches metadata `targetRefName` and `sourceRefName` into namespaced refs and runs `git diff {baseSha}...{headSha}`.

assertions.name: matching_workspace_prevents_clone
assertions.text: Before clone fallback, the current Copilot checkout's normalized Git remotes are compared with the exact ADO org/project/repo identity and metadata remoteUrl/sshUrl. A match sets it as `source_repo` and no clone command or clone-auth prompt occurs.

assertions.name: review_isolated_in_detached_worktree
assertions.text: The matching workspace is used only to fetch namespaced refs; the workflow creates or safely reuses a clean `git worktree add --detach` path keyed by PR ID and head SHA, leaves the workspace branch and working tree untouched, and sets `repo_path` to the detached worktree.

assertions.name: ado_comment_post_uses_rest_resource
assertions.text: When the user approves an ADO comment, the workflow JSON-encodes one comment body and posts it with `az devops invoke --area git --resource pullRequestThreads`, the same route identifiers, API version 7.1, POST, and `--in-file`; it never invokes nonexistent `az repos pr thread create`.
